numeric_rule: Use only (printed current month / printed prior month from the same original PDF - 1) * 100, provided both are positive. Never use printed rounded dollar change or splice absolute export levels. Retain source month, PDF SHA-256, release header and classification regime.
definition_rule: Quarantine the January 2012 same-report MoM due to the official semiconductor-media reclassification effective that month. Do not emit its value. Carry the last previously published eligible same-vintage MoM until the February 2012 report becomes conservatively available, preserving source age and pre-change regime; never backfill January.
availability_rule: Parse the printed U.S. Eastern 08:30 release calendar date from the exact report. Make the source usable only at 09:31 on the following actual Qlib trading session, then map the latest eligible release to each Stage1 signal date at that session close or later. Never use report-month end or same-day release values.
